title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Science - Biology
subject: General Science

questions.q: Through which method of cell division are the diploid chromosomes divided into haploid gametes?
questions.explain: Meiosis is a reductional division process where a single cell divides twice to produce four cells containing half the original amount of genetic information (haploid gametes).
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: Asthma primarily affects which part of the respiratory system?
questions.explain: Asthma is a chronic respiratory condition that causes inflammation and narrowing of the airways, primarily affecting the bronchi and bronchioles.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: During reproduction, why is it important to create DNA copies?
questions.explain: DNA copying (replication) is essential in reproduction because it ensures that the newly formed cells receive an exact copy of the genetic material, which is critical for the inheritance of traits from parents to offspring.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: When water and nutrients are available, algae grow and multiply rapidly by the process of __________.
questions.explain: Algae typically reproduce vegetatively by fragmentation, where each fragment grows into a new individual rapidly when favorable conditions (water and nutrients) are present.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: Which of the following options best describes the term Culture Fishery?
questions.explain: Culture fishery (or aquaculture) refers to the rearing and farming of fishes under controlled conditions.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: Which poultry are birds farmed to produce eggs?
questions.explain: In poultry farming, birds that are raised specifically for egg production are known as 'layers', while those raised for meat are called 'broilers'.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: Which of the following plant tissue performs photosynthesis?
questions.explain: Chlorenchyma is a specialized type of parenchyma tissue that contains chloroplasts, and is therefore capable of performing photosynthesis.
questions.subject: General Science

questions.q: Which of the following life processes is important to bring variation in species?
questions.explain: Sexual reproduction involves the fusion of male and female gametes, combining genetic material from two parents which creates genetic variation in the resulting offspring.
questions.subject: General Science
